Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Subject:- Intimation of Post Earnings Conference Call 
 
We wish to inform you that, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations 
and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Post Earnings Conference Call of 
the Company is scheduled on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 17:30 Hrs. (IST). The 
details of the said call are enclosed with this letter. 
 
Details of the Post Earnings Conference Call will be also published on the Company's 
website in due course. 
 
Kindly take the same on your records. 
 
Thanking you.
